name: PlateSight: License Plate Recognition
highlights: Reads license plate numbers entirely in the browser: a YOLO11 detector finds each plate, a vision-transformer reader turns it into text, and Ghana's plate formats correct the reading.
Reads 79% of 310 hand-labelled Ghanaian plates exactly, every character, end to end, with models never trained on a Ghanaian plate; format-aware decoding alone adds 4.5 points.

Detectors trained on a cloud GPU with a reproducible PyTorch/Ultralytics pipeline: 0.87–0.89 mAP@50 on 2,065 real-world photos, 0.95 on Ghanaian plates. INT8 was rejected by an accuracy gate; float16 weights halved downloads with no loss.
ONNX Runtime Web in Web Workers with WebGPU and WebAssembly, nothing uploaded; live webcam reading and one-click redaction.
